_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 70: 6-7 May 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is his word and he told them these things are coming, that Matthew 24 will happen and they are not going to go against the word, that the Lord told them they will see these things, and that when they see them it should not be a shock at all.
mentions.quote: when we're seeing these things, it shouldn't be a shock at all to us
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it pre-empts surprise either way: the events are expected, so their arrival confirms and their absence is not yet.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is raising up key figures and key voices in this end time army that will be on an amplification with an amplified voice so loud that everyone will hear it, and reports being told I am turning up the volume and increasing the supply.
mentions.quote: I'm turning up the volume. I'm increasing the supply
mentions.falsify_match: Measurable growth in the reach of these voices, which is countable.
mentions.falsify_miss: No growth. Amplification is at least visible in audience figures, unlike most of this material.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know exactly when the date is, that he believes it is 2027 or the fall of 2027 or 2028, asks whether it could be off and answers yes, that this is what he feels in his spirit and what he is praying over, and that Trump was in power when it happened.
mentions.quote: I don't know exactly when the date is. Could it be off? Yeah
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic in that window while this administration is in office.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing in it. The hedge is real and unprompted: he says outright the date could be off.

mentions.claim_text: He reads the Psalm 91 promise about deliverance from the snare of the fowler and from the pestilence, glosses the pestilence as meaning the virus on the boat, and continues through the covering and the shield.
mentions.quote: That means the virus on the boat
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and the gloss is his own: an ancient text read as naming a specific present outbreak.

mentions.claim_text: He tells them to stand on Psalm 91 verse 10 concerning any of these viruses that are coming and concerning any wars, and repeats that no evil shall befall them, that it does not matter what it is, that none shall, and that it is not going to hurt them.
mentions.quote: No evil. None. Shall befall you. It's not going to hurt you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the exemption applied directly to the plague he has just forecast: the audience is told it cannot touch them.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are supposed to be a voice and not an echo, that the Lord has told them many times to say the things that are hard and that eventually they will come out in the news, and that this holds regardless of people thinking they are on a bandwagon.
mentions.quote: we're supposed to be a voice, not an echo
mentions.falsify_match: The hard things appearing in the news afterwards, which is the accuracy claim in testable form.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know whether they remember, that they are just at the beginning, and that there are going to be major events coming in the next months and years that will shake America beyond anything they can comprehend.
mentions.quote: major events coming in the next months, years that's going to shake America
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Beyond anything you can comprehend has no threshold and no date.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether everyone remembers and says the Lord said this is not funny and these people are deceived in what is about to take place, dates it to October the 26th of 2025, and says the Lord warned them and they saw something coming.
mentions.quote: These people are deceived in what's about to take place
mentions.falsify_match: The 26 October telling is in this corpus and can be read against whatever he now offers as its fulfilment.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not say what he says it says.

mentions.claim_text: He corrects which clip is wanted, says this is January the 21st of 2024 and a vision he saw, and that right before the visitation was over the Lord said that right before his coming there is going to be something.
mentions.quote: This is January the 21st of 2024. This is a vision I saw
mentions.falsify_match: The 21 January 2024 recording is in this corpus and is played on air, so it can be checked directly.
mentions.falsify_miss: The recording does not contain it.

mentions.claim_text: The clip concerns where the body of Christ goes when the rapture of the church takes place, and they confirm that was 2024 before moving on.
mentions.quote: where the body of Christ goes when the rapture of the church takes place
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a description of a destination after an event that has not occurred.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is March 18th of 2026 a couple of weeks ago, that he had it until today when everybody sent this stuff to him, that he does not know when the meeting was but from what he understands an actual meeting took place, and that in this he sees what they are about to release to the American people.
mentions.quote: an actual meeting took place. I see what they're about to release
mentions.falsify_match: A disclosure to the public matching what he says he saw, with the 18 March telling in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such release. He says himself he does not know when the meeting was.

mentions.claim_text: He tells them to pay attention to the pyramids and to the hieroglyphics on the Mayan pyramids, says this is not an accident because this is what they see, that there is something dark about it, and that they have hidden and buried it over generations.
mentions.quote: Pay attention to the hieroglyphics on the Mayan pyramids
mentions.falsify_match: A disclosure connecting ancient carvings to what is being released.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Buried and hidden over generations means absence of evidence is folded into the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is telling them it seems way out there, that this is why he tiptoes around it and just goes okay, but that the Lord showed him and said to tell them all that a great deception is coming, and repeats that a great deception is coming.
mentions.falsify_match: A mass deception event, most likely the disclosure he is describing.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Great deception has no threshold, and he notes himself that he tiptoes around the subject.

mentions.claim_text: He says the pains will take place and this will begin on April 1st of this year, but that the signs now will be about the skies and the heavens, and that for a great deception things will start to take place in the heavens.
mentions.quote: the signs now will be about the skies, the heavens
mentions.falsify_match: Celestial events used to advance a deception.
mentions.falsify_miss: None beyond the ordinary. It joins the April signs claim to the deception claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says that on September the 11th of this year they will double again, that the Lord said they will double again, that it runs from April 1st to Rosh Hashanah, and that he said to watch this timeframe, asking whether they remember and to comment.
mentions.quote: Then they will double again on September the 11th
mentions.falsify_match: A further marked acceleration from 11 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Doubling a quantity that was never measured, twice, on a date that already carries the attack claim.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces a forty second clip about UFO disclosure and plays it, in which someone is asked whether the year 2027 was mentioned in those meetings and answers that they sure did, that they mentioned that date in particular as being a key moment.
mentions.quote: When you were in these meetings did they mention the year 2027?
mentions.falsify_match: A disclosure event in 2027, though the claim is someone else's rather than his.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing in 2027. Worth recording that the 2027 date here comes from another person's interview, not from a sighting.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is a two minute clip and he will not keep it up, tells them to watch the whole video that the other man has, that there was a meeting and supposedly they talked about it, that he does not understand it and has to watch all of it, and that Braden edited it down to the highlights so they should follow that channel.
mentions.quote: Braden edited it down to get the highlights
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: sourcing another channel's material and saying he has not yet watched it in full.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was invited to go to a certain state to hear some men in the United States government and others share a concern they had, that he will not name this particular man, and that they may end up doing some teachings with him or holding an event.
mentions.quote: invited to a certain state to hear some men in the government
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as given: the state, the men and the concern are all withheld.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of June, July and August going into the period before the elections, identifies the man on screen as Pastor Larry Ragland and confirms the name and that he believes he is a pastor.
mentions.quote: June, July, August going into that before the elections
mentions.falsify_match: Political upheaval across the summer before the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The summer window now carries the theatre, the acceleration and the revival all at once.
